sections.overview: This widespread kingfisher occurs across the tropical Indo-Pacific.
sections.identification: It has blue-green upperparts, a white collar and pale underparts.
sections.habitat: It uses coasts, wetlands and other open habitats.
sections.diet: It takes fish, crabs, lizards, insects and amphibians.
sections.behavior: It hunts from perches and beats larger prey before eating.
sections.reproduction: Pairs dig nest tunnels; both parents care for the young.
sections.ecology: In Sulawesi it is a resident breeder, unlike the migratory Sacred Kingfisher that winters there.
sections.conservation: BirdLife International lists it globally as Least Concern, while noting a decreasing population trend.
